title: Tenma Saki — Wishes Take Flight〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oooh, this bathtub is all decorated too! It's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, that ducky inner tube!
I used one like that when I was little.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa would kick his legs and push from behind, and I'd go quacking all the way!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hahaha, that really takes me back!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, there's so many flowers blooming too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I've seen these ones before! What were they called?
Ohh, if only Ichi were here, she'd know!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Here's the lawn!
Hehehe, I bet it'd feel so nice to walk on it barefoot♪
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? They have a keyboard!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wooow!
It's the exact one I use!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Does this mean whoever lives here does music too?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, there's something on that table too.
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Origami cranes, and some staff paper?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Maybe somebody was writing music.
But all the sheets are blank...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? What's this? It looks like a mailbox... Ahh!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
The base fell through?!
Now the stuff inside all fell out!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What are these?
They look like greeting cards...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa! They're being blown away by the wind!
Wait, come back!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
I managed to get them all back...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm glad none fell in the pool. Actually, they didn't get dirty, did they...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Someone's Writing
rows.Line: “I spent all that time studying, and I still did terrible. Why can't I be good at this like Sis...”

rows.Speaker: Someone's Writing
rows.Line: “Why'd they have to pick me to be a team regular? The next tournament was my senior's last chance.”

rows.Speaker: Someone's Writing
rows.Line: “Dad keeps asking why I won't go to college. I mean, we don't have that kinda money... I've just gotta think of this as giving back to the family that raised me.”

rows.Speaker: Someone's Writing
rows.Line: “Don't ask me what I want to do with my future. How should I know? I spend all my time studying. I don't even have a single hobby.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
These...remind me of the comments on that video.
But these don't really feel like comments... It's more like I'm reading their thoughts.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This person sounds like they have a job...
And this one... Must be from a parent raising kids.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They all sound so pained...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Maybe the people who wrote these are holding all this in, unable to tell anyone...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that's it...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was just about to work on a new song, hoping our music could get people to look up more.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And there's staff paper and a keyboard right here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'll be using them without permission, but...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want to reach them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want my feelings, my music, to reach these people.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll be borrowing this staff paper and your keyboard!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Okay, let's think!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (How can I be there for the people who wrote these messages?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (What comes to mind for me is...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (If you're hurting, you can say so. When you want to cry, go ahead and cry...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (You don't have to push yourself so hard or hold yourself back. Something like that...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sometimes you just can't bring yourself to talk about it, and sometimes you want to hold back the tears no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Maybe you're ashamed to let people see you that way, or you don't want them to worry...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want this song to be there for people feeling that way too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: To begin with, worries aren't always something you can just think your way through.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: When you look at it that way, it's like, just worrying about something is already really noble...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I think I felt something coming on just now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll try playing a little...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Something's off...
It should be warmer, something that flows into the ears gently...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, that was good...!
Gotta write it down so I don't forget...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hmm, it's pretty close to what I was imagining...
But I think it should be more than just warm, like it needs something strong at its core...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Maybe it sounds that way because of this floaty closing here.
Then, I'll make this part more crisp and...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I did it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I only finished one phrase... But I think it captures what I'm feeling perfectly!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, but playing it here isn't gonna help me reach the people who wrote those cards.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll just bring this sheet music back with me, and then I can make it into a full song some—

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? The table is... No, the staff paper is glowing?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?! The sheets are folding up into little cranes...!
There's so many!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What's happening? These are from the same pile of staff paper I was just using, right...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, they're flying...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (They're circling the keyboard...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Are they trying to tell me to play?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! The sheet music I wrote is glowing too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right. I did make the effort to write it and all!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, ready?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (The cranes are taking off into the sky...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Could you take this song to everyone for me?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (When it comes to solving your worries, you don't know if you'll accomplish it tomorrow, or if you need to spend a year working on it first...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (You might spend your whole life looking for the answer. They're your worries, but even you don't know how long they'll be with you.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But I... I know that you're thinking about them today.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Morning came, but you still have all this unease, and you have to go to school or your job or do housework...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (At times like those, everyone around you starts to look so blinding, and sometimes it can make you feel down about yourself...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But... I want you to know...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (You haven't given up on finding the answer, and that makes you the coolest person ever in my eyes!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: May these feelings reach you...!
School SEKAI
Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? I'm back at the rooftop...
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Welcome back, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Luka...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right! Luka, let me tell you what just happened!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I picked up this ball, and next thing I knew I was in an adorable yard! It was all decked out with the kinda stuff I like and... Wait, that's not important!
The staff paper was cranes, and they folded up, and flew away...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Calm down, Saki.
Just now, you were in a SEKAI formed from a fragment of a feeling.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A SEKAI formed from...a fragment of a feeling?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. It was still only just a fragment, so the SEKAI couldn't maintain its form like this one does.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So touching on that feeling only lets you visit for a short amount of time, and then you're sent back out.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I see...
But why was the fragment sitting around here?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I have a feeling it must have been drawn to you girls' feelings, the ones that make up this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You've decided on your individual aspirations and what you want to achieve as a group, so those feelings are stronger than ever.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Right!
I sure hope that's what happened!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I don't know if what I played back there reached anyone...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But I want to make sure that I do someday.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I want Leo/need to touch their hearts.)
